title: メディアデザイン
subtitle: Media Design
educationalGoal:
This course introduces excellent examples of design and art using media technology. Its purpose is to help students to understand how to use media technology in order to create design value. Content examples using XR technology such as VR, AR, and MR are also introduced.

In addition, students will acquire the basic methods of visual expression and interactive expression using graphic software and codes.
advice:
This course introduces excellent examples of design and art using media technology. Its purpose is to help students to understand how to use media technology in order to create design value. Content examples using XR (VR, AR, MR) technology  are also introduced.

Furthermore, students will:
1) Understand the basic methods of visual expression and interactive expression using graphic software and codes.
2) Acquire basic visual theory of visual representation such as harmony, proportion, and balance.
3) Acquire mathematical concepts such as symmetry, the Fibonacci Sequence, and the Golden Ratio, which are the basics of visual expression, and then practice visual expression based on those concepts.
4) Create original image expressions by coding.
requiredKnowledge:
Programming skill is required.

Drawing experience using a paint software application is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand examples of design and art using media technology.
Be able to understand examples of contents using XR.
Be able to construct images based on visual theory.
Be able to create media contents such as dynamic image expressions.
Be able to generate digital images by coding.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course introduces excellent examples of design and art using media technology. Its purpose is to help students to understand how to use media technology in order to create design value. Content examples using XR (VR, AR, MR) technology  are also introduced.

Furthermore, students will:
1) Understand the basic methods of visual expression and interactive expression using graphic software and codes.
2) Acquire basic visual theory of visual representation such as harmony, proportion, and balance.
3) Acquire mathematical concepts such as symmetry, the Fibonacci Sequence, and the Golden Ratio, which are the basics of visual expression, and then practice visual expression based on those concepts.
4) Create original image expressions by coding.
